data.body: Session update (2026-08-17): completed agent-skills decomposition and dependency graphs for RP-02 and RP-03, then ran plan review only in dependency-safe order from a dedicated clean worktree refreshed to origin/main 034e17209c before every review. Full graph and certification record are on rubellite-secondary-cub.
